# NFL Daily Digest — 2026-07-25 (Past 1 day)

## A. Summary
- 07/25: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan broke his nose, three ribs and a hand and suffered a severe concussion in a July 14 car crash; he will be limited as camp opens, with OL coach Chris Foerster serving as acting head coach. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2081047312063766781)
- 07/25: Patriots owner Robert Kraft says the team has offered CB Christian Gonzalez a deal that would make him the NFL's highest-paid CB, above Trent McDuffie's $31M/year benchmark. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49447151/kraft-patriots-gonzalez-offer-highest-paid-cb-ever)
- 07/25: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes fully cleared for training camp after last year's knee surgery. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49442364/chiefs-patrick-mahomes-fully-cleared-training-camp-feeling-amazing)
- 07/25: 49ers placing TE George Kittle (Achilles), DL Mykel Williams (ACL), RB Isaac Guerendo (pec) and DL Alfred Collins (shoulder) on PUP to open camp. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2081094201161199959)
- 07/25: Rams QB Ty Simpson (No. 13 overall) signed his four-year, $25.4M fully guaranteed rookie deal, completing the 2026 first-round class. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2081079483730157832)

- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## C. News
- 07/25: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan injured in a July 14 car crash — broken nose, three broken ribs, broken hand, severe concussion, 40+ facial stitches; limited to start training camp. Police say no drugs or alcohol were involved and no one was cited. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2081047312063766781) — also [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7469758/2026/07/25/kyle-shanahan-car-accident-49ers/)
- 07/25: 49ers name assistant HC/OL coach Chris Foerster acting head coach while Shanahan is limited; GM John Lynch does not expect Shanahan to miss Week 1. [Garafolo](https://x.com/MikeGarafolo/status/2081084911889392016)
- 07/25: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes fully cleared for camp after knee surgery, says he feels "amazing." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49442364/chiefs-patrick-mahomes-fully-cleared-training-camp-feeling-amazing)
- 07/25: 49ers place TE George Kittle (Achilles), DL Mykel Williams (ACL), RB Isaac Guerendo (pec) and DL Alfred Collins (shoulder) on PUP. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2081094201161199959)
- 07/25: Patriots have offered CB Christian Gonzalez a contract above $31M/year that would make him the highest-paid CB ever, per owner Robert Kraft; deal not yet done. [Garafolo](https://x.com/MikeGarafolo/status/2081045326870311301) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49447151/kraft-patriots-gonzalez-offer-highest-paid-cb-ever)
- 07/25: 49ers WR Brandon Aiyuk remains on the left-squad list as he pushes for his release; GM John Lynch declines further comment. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2081082873801511279) — also [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7469828/2026/07/25/49ers-brandon-aiyuk-john-lynch/)
- 07/25: Rams HC Sean McVay says Aaron Donald is in a "very strict, regimented process" as he weighs a comeback; no answer yet on a return. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49448508/retired-donald-regimented-process-possible-rams-return) — also [FOX](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/los-angeles-rams-aaron-donald-unretire-rams-sean-mcvay)
- 07/25: Rams WR Puka Nacua expected to practice while he seeks a new deal. [NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-news-roundup-latest-league-updates-from-saturday-july-25)
- 07/25: Bears place CB Kyler Gordon, LB Noah Sewell, LB Keyshaun Elliott, OL Ozzy Trapilo and DL Shemar Turner on PUP; LB T.J. Edwards on NFI with a minor muscle strain, short stay expected. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2081115660474609691)
- 07/25: Cardinals activate LT Paris Johnson Jr. from PUP. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2081094201161199959)
- 07/25: Rams QB Ty Simpson signs his rookie deal (4 years, $25.4M fully guaranteed, $14.94M signing bonus); all 2026 first-rounders now signed. [NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/news/2026-first-round-class-signed-and-sealed-rams-ty-simpson-inks-rookie-deal)
- 07/25: CBS NFL analyst Tony Romo arrested on suspicion of OWI. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49441463/cbs-nfl-analyst-tony-romo-arrested-suspicion-owi)
- 07/25: Former NFL guard Jordan Devey died at 38; his family says he died by suicide. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jordan-devey-dies-age-38/)
- 07/25: Packers president/CEO Ed Policy says the NFL's only publicly owned franchise may need financial adjustments to stay competitive long term. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49442413/packers-ceo-says-financial-bump-needed-stay-competitive)
- 07/25: Retired QB Will Grier joins the Cowboys coaching staff as an offensive assistant. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49441578/source-ex-cowboys-qb-grier-returns-offensive-assistant)
